title: Blind Crown — Nightfall
description: Private-plan medieval archery for 2–10 contestant slots. Nightfall adds armored knights, three diorama arenas, four cameras, readable volleys and paused tactical round reviews. Classic and Precision rules preserved. One local human plus bots; hosted phone multiplayer is not integrated.
